text:
ashley (Finance): Heads up — customer ACME has a Private VPC deployment in eu-west-1 and their invoice shows two surprise lines: 1) a monthly GPU usage charge we committed to with the cloud partner, 2) an "NVIDIA driver/license" pass-through line. They're asking if we should absorb them under the Dedicated/reserved contract or pass them through. Any thoughts?

carlos (Eng-Infra): Is this the deployment that was pinned to a dedicated reservation we bought last quarter? If so we can pro-rate the committed hours to the customer. Need the reservation ID to map.

ashley (Finance): Yes it's the 12mo reservation (commitment_id: rsv-9a2f). The cloud bill tags the VMs with `redwood.deployment=private` and `redwood.customer=acme`. But license fee is a separate invoice line from the provider.

maria (Sales): ACME expects predictable monthly charges. They signed a private deployment SOW but didn't explicitly accept third-party license pass-through language. We should confirm contract language before hitting them with a surprise charge. :grimacing:

ben (RevOps): Agree — from an invoicing perspective we can either (A) absorb license as part of our platform fee and eat net margin, or (B) create a pass-through line item with exact provider invoice attached. For (B) we need a clean mapping so compliance/tax works.

carlos (Eng-Infra): Technical mapping notes — if you export the provider billing to GCS/BigQuery you can run a quick join on `resource.tags` and `commitment_id`. Example BigQuery snippet we use:

```
SELECT
  invoice_month,
  invoice_line_item_id,
  labels.key AS tag_key,
  labels.value AS tag_value,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `project.billing_export.gcp_billing` b,
UNNEST(b.labels) AS labels
WHERE labels.key = 'redwood.customer'
  AND labels.value = 'acme'
  AND invoice_month = '2026-02'
GROUP BY invoice_month, invoice_line_item_id, tag_key, tag_value
```

carlos (Eng-Infra): If reservation usage is < committed hours, provider still bills full commitment. We typically amortize the commitment across all customers using that reservation by `gpu_hours_allocated` tag. For private deployments we recommend creating per-customer reservations when contracts justify it.

ashley (Finance): Good point — for ACME we overprovisioned by ~30% last month. If we pass-through the entire commitment they'd see their share + our amortized share. That could be awkward.

maria (Sales): What about a hybrid: absorb a fixed baseline GPU license (e.g., first 100 GPU-hours/month) and pass-through marginal usage + explicit license lines? That aligns incentives and keeps ACME invoice stable.

ben (RevOps): Technically doable. We'll need to update billing automation to: (1) attach provider invoice PDF for any pass-through lines, (2) create a separate invoice code `PASS_THROUGH_LICENSE`, (3) record margin waterfall for finance. I can add an item to the billing playbook.

carlos (Eng-Infra): Also note region constraints — eu-west pricing includes regional taxes and the provider invoices VAT. If we pass-through, VAT flows to the customer differently depending on their VAT reg. We should consult tax/legal before finalizing.

ashley (Finance): I'll draft options for ACME: (1) Redwood absorbs license for next 2 months while we renegotiate (2) Hybrid pass-through as Maria suggested (3) Full pass-through with invoice attachment. Will include cost breakdown using the BigQuery query.

maria (Sales): Thanks. I'll pause any escalation to the customer until we have a recommended option. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployed cost-export job to `billing-export-eu`. Next run in 4h.

ashley (Finance): Thanks — tagging @carlos to fetch reservation utilization and @ben to prep the invoice code. We'll sync in 2h. :white_check_mark:
